column1: # Coverage floors (ADR-010) — a floor is a RATCHET.
# Raise a floor when a layer improves; never lower one to make a build pass.
# validate-coverage-floors.sh fails when a floor decreases or a layer
# disappears, compared against the merge base.
# Columns (tab-separated): layer  floor  measured  target  note
#   floor     the value that gates (ratchet; never decreases)
#   target    the roadmap criterion (gap printed when unmet)
